turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi. I picked up this shirt yesterday, and there's still a stain on it. It's the second time this has happened.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Yes, I can see it. When was the first time?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Two weeks ago, with my white shirt. You cleaned it again and it was fine, but now it's happened again with this one.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I'm really sorry. We can clean it again for free. It will be ready tomorrow at five.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: The problem is, I need it for a job interview tomorrow morning at nine. Tomorrow at five is too late.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I see. In that case, we can do an express clean. It can be ready today at six, or tomorrow at eight in the morning. Both are free.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Eight is too close to my interview, so I'll come back today at six. Could you check it carefully this time, please?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Of course. I'll check it myself before you come.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you. So it'll be ready today at six, and there's no charge.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That's right. Good luck with your interview!
